def checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int | None:
    """Sum of a and b, or None when the sum does not fit in a 64-bit signed int."""
    ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
    ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) is None
    ex checked_add(-9223372036854775808, -1) is None
    ex checked_add(-9223372036854775808, 1) == -9223372036854775807
    hi = 9223372036854775807
    lo = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    if b > 0 and a > hi - b:
        return None
    if b < 0 and a < lo - b:
        return None
    return a + b
